target.title: feat(stepfun): add step-3.7-flash model
target.body:
## Summary

- Add `step-3.7-flash` to the bundled StepFun provider plugin on both surfaces (`stepfun`, `stepfun-plan`).
- Make `step-3.7-flash` the default model (`STEPFUN_DEFAULT_MODEL_ID`); propagates to onboarding + provider registration via the derived `STEPFUN_*_DEFAULT_MODEL_REF`.
- Specs: 262,144 context, reasoning, multimodal input `["text","image","video"]`, cost `input $0.20 / output $1.15 / cached-input $0.04` per 1M tokens (source: https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/guides/models/step-3.7-flash).
- Update tests (`EXPECTED_*_MODELS`) and docs (`docs/providers/stepfun.md`, `docs/concepts/model-providers.md`).

## Files

- `extensions/stepfun/openclaw.plugin.json` — model entries on both providers
- `extensions/stepfun/provider-catalog.ts` — default model id bump
- `src/agents/models-config.providers.stepfun.test.ts` — expected model arrays
- `docs/providers/stepfun.md`, `docs/concepts/model-providers.md`

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed**: `step-3.7-flash` is discoverable and available on both `stepfun` and `stepfun-plan` after this change, and is the new default model.
- **Real environment tested**: built and ran the OpenClaw CLI from this branch on macOS, Node 22, pnpm 11.2.2, with an isolated config home and `STEPFUN_API_KEY` set.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
  ```
  pnpm openclaw models list --provider stepfun
  pnpm openclaw models list --provider stepfun-plan
  ```
- **Evidence after fix**:
  ```
  Model                                      Input      Ctx         Local Auth  Tags
  stepfun/step-3.5-flash                     text       256k        no    yes
  stepfun/step-3.7-flash                     text+image 256k        no    yes

  Model                                      Input      Ctx         Local Auth  Tags
  stepfun-plan/step-3.5-flash                text       256k        no    yes
  stepfun-plan/step-3.5-flash-2603           text       256k        no    yes
  stepfun-plan/step-3.7-flash                text+image 256k        no    yes
  ```
- **Observed result after fix**: `openclaw models list` shows `stepfun/step-3.7-flash` and `stepfun-plan/step-3.7-flash`, both with `available: true` and `contextWindow: 262144` (256k). The live provider catalog object resolves `cost` to `{input: 0.2, output: 1.15, cacheRead: 0.04, cacheWrite: 0}`.
- **What was not tested**: no live inference request against the StepFun API (no production key); pricing values taken from the official StepFun model docs.
